actions.command:
cd /app && git add -A && git commit -m "feat: add duration-aware sharding strategies to sequence config

Add 12 new sequence config fields for duration-aware sharding:
- shardStrategy: hash | time | round-robin | affinity
- balanceShardsByTime
- recordFileDurations
- durationBasedSorting
- durationHistoryTTL, durationHistoryPath, durationHistoryMaxRuns
- durationSmoothing: latest | average | p95 | median
- shardAffinityRules
- rebalanceThreshold, isolateSlowThreshold
- durationFallbackStrategy: hash | equal-split

All fields are validated at startup and serialized to worker config.
Implements a duration history file with TTL, smoothing, legacy migration,
affinity glob rules, LPT/round-robin/equal-split sharding, slow-file
isolation, rebalance warnings, and duration-based sorting." && git log --oneline -3
